findings_en: The authenticated class map is 1=Hey Vosen and 2=Hey Mero; all 29 weak-positive source rows match their original canonical phrase and requested index.
At 10 dB, observed weak-positive matches improved from 15/17 to 17/17 in training and from 7/11 to 8/11 in development: three rescued cases and zero event-correctness regressions.
Development Hey Mero improved from 5/8 to 6/8; development Hey Vosen remained 2/3. Only one additional development case was rescued.

All 29 clean weak-positive cases retained a correct event. The 48 synthetic negative-intent cases and 40 read-speech tracks remained event-free in clean; all 48 mixed negative-intent cases also remained event-free.

The three remaining development misses consist of two cases without three consecutive qualifying frames and one case that never reached the fixed threshold within the observation window. No prefix, wrong-keyword or extra same-keyword events were observed.

Zero event-correctness regressions does not imply uniformly improved scores or timing: peak target confidence decreased in two previously missed development cases, and one clean event occurred 80 ms later.
Retain the candidate as an L1 weak-research checkpoint. Do not promote it automatically or replace the product SDK; candidate C-head numeric parity and independent FAR/FRR were not run.
findings_zh: 认证的类别映射为 1=Hey Vosen，2=Hey Mero；29条弱正样本均与原始 canonical_phrase/requested_keyword_index 逐条吻合。
10 dB下，训练弱正样本15/17→17/17，开发弱正样本7/11→8/11；共救回3条，事件正确性回退0条。
开发 Hey Mero 5/8→6/8；开发 Hey Vosen 2/3→2/3。新增救回仅1条开发样本，证据规模很小。
clean的29条弱正样本均保持正确事件，48条合成负意图与40条普通朗读背景保持0事件；10dB的48条弱负意图也保持0事件。
仍未触发的3条开发样本中，2条没有形成连续3帧合格分数，1条在观察窗内从未达到0.8阈值；没有前缀事件、跨词事件或同词额外事件。
事件正确性无回退不等于所有分数和时序均改善：2条原本未触发的开发样本峰值分数下降；clean中1条事件晚80ms。
保留候选作为L1弱监督研究检查点；不自动晋级、不替换产品SDK。新候选C-head数值一致性与独立FAR/FRR均未测。

limitations.acoustic_causation: Saved score trajectories explain event-rule failure, but do not establish the true phonetic or acoustic cause.
limitations.unobserved_future_frames: No inference after the fixed 320 ms post-clip context.

protocol.candidate_training: original-head warm start, clean/noisy balanced, fixed 96 additional updates
protocol.mix_region: original clip only; original prefix/context preserved
protocol.scientific_comparison: augmentation plus additional updates; not a pure single-variable or loss ablation
protocol.snr_interval: whole original source clip, including any source silence

recommendation.next_predeclared_research_hypothesis: Evaluate whether a training objective that rewards sustained positive evidence better matches the unchanged three-frame event rule, using train-only decisions and a separately reserved evaluation set.
recommendation.next_validation_need: New pronunciation-reviewed, speaker-diverse positive and hard-negative recordings; fixed continuous-stream evaluation and candidate C-head parity before any promotion.
recommendation.reason: Three observed rescues including one development case, unchanged clean event correctness, and no new negative-intent events justify retaining the research checkpoint; small exposed weak data and three residual development misses do not establish deployable quality.
